items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: I left to join the Goldcat Orchestra in Detroit. I signed a contract with Goldcat for five years. And remained with him doing that entire time.

ctx.x: Steve Brown The Music World The Music World

Well, folks, my name is Steve Brown to the Music World. My real name is Ted Brown. I was born and raised in New Orleans, Louisiana. My parents had a musical background. I guess my brother and I, we were talented in that respect. We began playing early in our teens. And I guess just after our father and mother's death, we were quite young and we fooled around with different types of musical instruments and gradually decided to stay on one instrument. And the trombone was my brother's and bass fiddle was mine. And…
Let's go. Let's start all over again, and I'll, I'll ask you a question. What date were you born and where?

This is my pretty girl's song. You had that too. Okay. Now, turn it on the other side. Sing with the... That's still pretty good. Yeah. Yeah. Now, turn it on the other side. That's still pretty good. Yeah. Yeah.
Now, turn it on the other side. I think we've got more on my record than on most ones. Come on, Gild.

Well, this is a homemade recording. The fellow recorded this in the Detroit for me. This is power. Yeah, that's a record. Let's play the original. Let's see. Play that last part and see if you can get that other number that I said.
